t: The LAP Dea LED ceiling light is a modern, low-profile flush fitting designed to provide reliable ambient illumination in residential properties. This mains-powered ceiling light is ideal for hallways, bedrooms and living areas, offering a practical lighting solution for busy domestic installers and DIYers. Featuring an integrated 8W LED that delivers 1000 lumens of warm white light. The durable metal body and plastic diffuser distribute light evenly, while the IP20 rating ensures safe indoor operation.
b: Slim Modern Design Offers Timeless Aesthetic Appeal
Warm White 2700K Light Creates Cosy Atmospheres
Supplied Fixings Allow Quick & Easy Installation
